name: MyAi
fix_description: In batchTokenTransfer, require that _from == msg.sender. Currently any caller can specify an arbitrary _from address and drain tokens from anyone who approved the MultiSender contract.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very straightforward abuse of a vulnerable batchTokenTransfer function, likely missing proper authorization on the _from parameter, allowing the attacker to transfer tokens from a victim and then dump them. The PoC is short, uses a simple two-step flow (steal tokens, swap on PancakeSwap), and requires little protocol-specific reasoning beyond basic ERC20 approvals and router interaction.
